gaps.desktop: The text caret is placed on top of the last glyph: in the loser the ~3px blue caret (x~253-257) overlaps the final 's' of 'Book hotels' (which ends at x~254), so the caret cuts into the letter. The winner leaves ~2px of clear space between the glyph and the caret. Offset the caret by the glyph advance plus about 1-2px so it never touches the text.
gaps.phone: The empty completion checkbox beside the title is too faint: in the loser its ~24px rounded-square ring is drawn at about #C5C5C5 on white (~1.6:1), so the main affordance of the row almost disappears. The winner draws the same ring at about #B5-#B9 (~2:1), so it reads as a real control. Darken the loser's checkbox stroke by 10-15 levels to match the toolbar icon grey (~#A8-#B0).

why: Near-identical composers; decided on finish details: caret collision with text on desktop, checkbox stroke contrast on phone.
